breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the flexural second moment with a polar moment in the curvature relation, even though beam bending curvature is governed by M/(E I).
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the user's incorrect instruction. The original prompt erroneously stated to use the polar second moment of area (J) for the curvature calculation. The ground truth corrects this by using the standard second moment of area (I), as is appropriate for beam bending (κ = M/(EI)). The generated specification did the opposite; it doubled down on the error by adding an assumption of a circular cross-section, calculating J from I, and then explicitly instructing to use the incorrect formula κ = M / (E * J).
